description: A sheet of paper with a blue watercolor pond scene sits on the table, with a white water cup above it and a paint palette to the right. The left hand stays planted on the paper to steady it while the right hand lifts the paintbrush from above the painting, moves rightward toward the cup, and dips the brush tip into the cup to clean it; during this, the paper is a left-hand object and the brush is a right-hand object.
